# Error Handling Checklist: Autopilot, Gate, and PR-Emission Repair

**Purpose**: Review failure boundaries, diagnostics, and safe recovery requirements across packet, gate, scaffold, completion, and review workflows.
**Created**: 2026-09-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `/speckit-checklist` from the feature requirements and Plan.
**Review Ownership**: A reviewer marks an item `[x]` only after deciding its requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. Checkbox state does not report implementation completion.

## Packet and final-emission failures

- [ ] CHK001 Are the three exempt untracked packet paths defined by the validated feature directory and current packet ID, without a directory-wide or other-packet exemption? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are unrelated tracked and untracked changes, tracked packet modifications, and unreadable Git status all specified as blockers for both packet mutation helpers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are malformed release notes and absent or invalid Phase 6.5 Verdict distinguished from omitted optional content, with final emission blocked where required? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-003, §FR-006]

## Reviewability and quality-gate failures

- [ ] CHK004 Are missing `spec_id`, missing selected section, and missing required budget fields given distinct invalid-request or blocking outcomes with named diagnostics and nonzero exits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011–FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the contract explicitly reject a malformed, mis-cased, placeholder, or unsupported selected-section `Reviewability-Exception` with a named reason, preserve normal budget evaluation, and block an over-budget result? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Are unrelated-section, generated-text, code-fence, and non-line-anchored pragmas barred from overriding the selected budget? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011–FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Are missing, extra, duplicate, placeholder, nonnumeric, and at-block slice rows specified to block with the offending slice or field named? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK008 Is an over-block aggregate acceptable only when every complete declared slice is below its applicable block line, with ordinary file and surface thresholds maintained for greenfield? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-028–FR-029]
- [ ] CHK009 Is a malformed or unknown declared quality command required to fail G0 with a named config diagnostic rather than letting a detected or absent command yield a green result? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]

## Completion and scaffold failures

- [ ] CHK010 Does the completion-boundary contract identify every missing, duplicate, pending, or in-progress Post row in both persisted records and refuse success even when no rows are recognized? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK011 Are missing child results, failed stop operations, or unconfirmed team cleanup required to prevent a clean executor result? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK012 Are dispatch error, empty return, and explicit operator abandonment the only no-findings continuations, with a distinct durable reason echoed in operator status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022–FR-023]
- [ ] CHK013 Is a late nonempty blind-spot result still usable, and are silence, elapsed time, and a whole-workflow stop excluded from operator abandonment? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-022–FR-023]

## Review-feedback failures and recovery

- [ ] CHK014 Do failed thread/comment pages, missing continuation cursors, and incomplete connection metadata block all review replies and resolutions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the outcome after failed full verification, including when local fixes were committed, specified as pending review threads with no push, reply, or resolution and a report naming the failed gate and retained local commit? [Recovery, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the outcome after a failed push, fresh-head query, or remote-head mismatch specified as pending review threads with no reply or resolution, retained local commit, and an actionable retry condition? [Recovery, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK017 Are serial reply, resolution, and read-back confirmation specified only after a successful push and fresh matching PR head, so no success path can pass on incomplete evidence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020–FR-021]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation of requirements quality.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` follows its separate built-in lifecycle.

**Second checklist pass**: Re-evaluated `/speckit-checklist error-handling` after the four requirements repairs. No new item was needed; CHK005, CHK009, CHK015, and CHK016 stay unchecked for reviewer evaluation, with their resolved gap markers removed.
